strict_success_rule: A conversion requires a durable pre-existing identity in the named community plus a currently reachable anonymous free operation that independently consumes an exact Agent Guild trust, passport, preflight, credential or result and returns attributable substantive evidence. Listings, probes, offers, schema checks, acknowledgements, caller-supplied-only validation and self-claimed identity do not qualify.

contract_evidence: README lines 175-196 declare five payment types and state that the client detects the Mech smart contract payment type and handles payment or validates a subscription NFT.
README lines 221-251 describe prepaid deposits and paid Nevermined subscription purchase as the alternatives to per-request payment.

machine_design_signals.signal: A required URL field typed null makes the advertised verifier impossible to call according to its own schema. Publish skillUrl as a URI string, or use a strict one-of contract for URL versus inline content.

Catalogs need machine-readable, authoritative distinctions among listing, callable execution authority, authentication requirement, normalized effective price, and result identity/signature. Without these fields, machines must infer readiness from marketing text and risk treating discovery as execution.
